admin.title: Platform admin
admin.reasonRequired: Give a reason — it is shown to the people affected and kept in the audit log.
admin.dashboard.hint: Everyone on this Mahaam installation, at a glance.
admin.users.hint: Every account. Suspend, reactivate, grant platform admin or sign someone out.
admin.users.signOutBody: Every session of {email} ends now. They can sign in again.
admin.users.suspendBody: {email} is signed out and can't sign in or use tokens until reactivated.
admin.users.selfNote: You can't suspend yourself or revoke your own admin access.
admin.users.noReset: Password reset isn't available: the auth plugin has no reset flow. Ask the user to register again with a different email, or reset it in the database.
admin.users.noWorkspaces: Not a member of any workspace
admin.workspaces.hint: Every workspace, its plan and how close it is to its limits.
admin.workspaces.suspendBody: Nobody can use {name} until it is reactivated. Its data is kept.
admin.workspaces.deleteBody: Every project, task, time entry and file in it is deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
admin.overrides.title: Overrides for this workspace
admin.overrides.hint: Anything left on "Inherit" follows the plan. An empty limit means unlimited.
admin.limit.invalidLimit: the limit must be a whole number, or empty for unlimited
admin.limit.invalidPrice: the price must be a non-negative number
admin.limit.invalidSize: the unit size must be a whole number of at least 1
admin.plans.hint: What each plan includes and costs. Changes apply to every workspace on the plan.
admin.plans.limitsHint: Leave a limit empty for unlimited. Overage bills each started unit of "unit size" over the limit at the unit price.
admin.plans.deactivateBody: Workspaces already on it keep it; it can't be chosen for new ones.
admin.plans.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Can't be changed later.
admin.plans.invalidKey: The key must be lowercase letters, digits, - or _ (and not "new").
admin.plans.invalidSort: The sort order must be a whole number.
admin.issues.redirecting: Platform issues live on the platform workspace's board. Taking you there…
admin.audit.hint: Every platform admin action, newest first.
plan.title: Sponsor open source
plan.hint: Mahaam is free and open source. There is no plan to buy and no limit to hit.
plan.legacy: This workspace has a subscription from before Mahaam became free. Nothing depends on it any more; open the billing portal to cancel it.
plan.voluntary: Sponsoring is voluntary and unlocks nothing: everyone gets the same Mahaam.
plan.body: Mahaam is free and open source, built on ToGO by Fady Mondy. Nothing is sold here and no feature is locked behind a plan. If it helps you, the best way to support it is to sponsor ToGO: every sponsorship goes into the framework and the apps built on it.
plan.noPermission: Only the workspace's owners and admins can see its plan and usage.
plan.estimateHint: An estimate: usage-based items keep counting until the end of the month.
suspended.workspaceBody: A platform administrator has suspended this workspace. Contact support to restore access.
suspended.accountBody: A platform administrator has suspended your account. Contact support to restore access.
billing.title: Billing
billing.notConfigured: Mahaam is free and open source: there is nothing to buy.
billing.paid: Mahaam is free and open source: there is nothing to buy.
billing.sync.title: Sync to Polar
billing.sync.hint: Create or update a Polar product for each plan. Preview first to see what would change.
billing.sync.confirmBody: Products in Polar are created or updated as previewed. Existing subscriptions aren’t changed.
